items.title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours
items.content: With GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, Codex, and Daybreak for cybersecurity, this AI lab builds agents that focus for days and improve with use.
items.contentSnippet: With GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, Codex, and Daybreak for cybersecurity, this AI lab builds agents that focus for days and improve with use.
items.summary: Third Moment Research实验室展示运行10,000个AI agents持续36+小时的能力，使用GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、Codex和Daybreak等模型，专注于网络安全领域，构建能够长时间持续运行并随使用改进的agent系统。
items.ai_reason: 核心领域的AI Agent大规模运行实践，但为新闻报道性质，缺乏深度技术细节，大规模agent编排有参考价值

items.title: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
items.content: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.
items.contentSnippet: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.
items.summary: Sophos利用OpenAI的Daybreak工具实现威胁调查自动化，将威胁调查时间缩短96%，并让52%的托管检测响应（MDR）案例实现自动化处理，同时保留人工监督机制。这是AI在安全运营领域的典型应用案例。
items.ai_reason: 属于AIOps安全运营领域的AI应用实践，有具体的量化效果数据（96%时间减少、52%自动化），符合核心关注领域，给予基础分+1，但属于产品应用案例而非深度技术分析
